subheading: CLINICAL FEATURES OF ACUTE PERI-APICAL ABSCESS
subheading_corrected: CLINICAL FEATURES OF ACUTE PERI-APICAL ABSCESS
text:
CLINICAL FEATURES OF ACUTE PERI-APICAL ABSCESS
- Painful swelling at the root of tooth
- Sinus (may be present)
- Tooth is tender to biting or percussion
- Tooth may be mobile
